Title: Azure Machine Learning available in US Gov

Body.Content:
Azure Machine Learning is now available in 2 Azure Government Regions: US Gov Arizona and US Gov Virgina.

With compliance submissions for FedRAMP High and DISA IL5, Azure can now support DoD and other Federal, State, Local organizations with their AI and machine learning workloads in these regions. 

The service in Azure Government is at feature parity with the Azure commercial cloud. 

Azure Machine Learning Basic Edition is generally available, and Enterprise Edition is in preview. 

For more information, see Azure Machine Learning page and pricing information.
